short: @zurfur/ui: the component library and its gallery
is: @zurfur/ui — a private SvelteKit library of components, consumed by `web` as TypeScript source, with its component gallery in Storybook (config in `.storybook/`, stories and docs pages in `src/stories/`), served on loopback by `just gallery`. The old Kit gallery (its routes, prerendered by adapter-static) still builds beside it until Storybook replaces it.
conventions: Consumed as source, no package step: `exports` gives `types` and `svelte` the same entry, `src/lib/index.ts`, and adds `./styles` (the side-effect styles entry, `src/lib/styles/index.ts`), `./tokens.json` and `./tokens.additions.json`; the version stays `0.0.0` and `web` depends on exactly that. Routes import the library only as `@zurfur/ui`, `@zurfur/ui/styles` or one of the two token files; `$lib` is banned in this package, since it would resolve to the importer's `src/lib`.

Plain client-side SvelteKit, nothing server-side: the gallery is prerendered (adapter-static, `strict`), files that run server code (`+server`, `.server.`, hooks) are refused by a check, and `vite.config.ts` may not rename them (no Kit `files`, no service worker, no svelte config file).

`eslint.config.js` partitions `src/` into file sets (checks, routes, gallery, stories, storage, motion, lazy, environment, and the components' rules for every other file) and runs with `noInlineConfig`, so no inline comment switches a rule off. The sets form three tiers, what ships (components, motion, lazy, environment) < the gallery host (routes, gallery, stories, storage) < the checks and specs, and a relative import never reaches a looser tier or leaves `src/`. A relative import of a file that is neither code nor CSS counts as the loosest tier unless it ends in exactly `?raw` or `?url`. A check holds `src/` to plain files and real folders (no symlink, FIFO, socket or device, and `src/` itself a real folder, all read without following links) and no `node_modules` folder or name holding a backslash, and refuses any file whose extension is off the list (`.ts`, `.svelte`, `.css`), except a folder's `NODE.inf.json`, `src/app.html` and the two token files `src/lib/styles/tokens.json` and `src/lib/styles/tokens.additions.json` by exact path: no other `.json` or `.html` file. No source file outside the checks names `fetch` or holds a remote URL or a `javascript:` URL in a string, and no component's markup holds a `<script>`, `<iframe>`, `<frame>`, `<object>` or `<embed>` element in any letter case, a `srcdoc` attribute, a `<svelte:element>` naming one of them by a static string, or an inline event handler: on an HTML element or a `<svelte:element>`, an `on…` attribute is allowed only in lower case with one expression as its value, which Svelte attaches as a listener (a component's props and a spread are not checked); the gallery's one boot script lives only in `src/app.html`, which ESLint never reads. The `storage` set holds only `src/gallery/skin-store.ts`, which may use `localStorage` and nothing else; every other file refuses all storage and `cookie`, and no file reaches the private file store (`navigator.storage`, `getDirectory`). The host may import exactly `@zurfur/ui`, `@zurfur/ui/styles`, `@zurfur/ui/tokens.json` and `@zurfur/ui/tokens.additions.json`. `{@html}`, `bind:innerHTML`, `createRawSnippet`, the `svelte/internal` modules and the raw-HTML DOM calls (`innerHTML`, `outerHTML`, `insertAdjacentHTML`, `setHTML`, `setHTMLUnsafe`, `createContextualFragment`, `DOMParser`, `parseFromString`, `parseHTMLUnsafe`, `document.write`) are refused everywhere, as are an `http-equiv` attribute in markup, `setAttribute` or `createAttribute` naming an `on…` attribute, `srcdoc` or `http-equiv`, and `createElement` naming one of the five elements, each by a static string. The network scan refuses a non-relative `@import`, any scheme but `data:` in CSS and any `http-equiv` attribute, and reads the page shell as a browser does (braces as text, each script parsed and its strings checked). Lint guards against accidental coupling, it is not a sandbox.

`just gallery` runs the `storybook` script: Storybook's dev server on 127.0.0.1 at `ZURFUR_GALLERY_PORT` or 5190, with `--exact-port`, so a busy port is an error (`gallery-port.ts` is the one port rule, read by the script and by `vite.config.ts`). The scripts that start Storybook or Vitest (`storybook`, `build-storybook`, `test`, `test:unit`) run under `env -i` with only PATH, HOME, ZURFUR_GALLERY_PORT and the network guard (the proxy variables, in both letter cases, at the closed port 127.0.0.1:9 with loopback direct, `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1`, telemetry off and its address closed), so nothing else from `.env` or the shell reaches the packages. The `storybook` and `build-storybook` scripts run `sh -c 'svelte-kit sync && exec storybook …'` inside that clean environment, since every install skips package scripts and Storybook's transforms need `.svelte-kit`; the `storybook` script computes its port there too, and the recipe prints the address under `env -i` with only PATH and ZURFUR_GALLERY_PORT; the install and yarn itself still see the recipe's `.env`. `src/checks/serve-config.spec.ts` pins those scripts and the Justfile's `gallery` and `gallery-build` recipes line for line, requires exactly that `svelte-kit sync && exec storybook` prefix in both bodies, and allows the port rule's one `$(…)` only inside the `sh -c` of a script that pins it; the guard, `env -i` and the recipes are security triggers.

`.storybook/` holds exactly four files, `main.ts`, `preview.ts`, `manager.ts` and `vitest.setup.ts` (`src/checks/storybook-config.spec.ts`), since Storybook loads `middleware.*` and `*-head.html` from the folder with no config key; the whole folder is a security trigger. `main.ts` holds only the allowed keys: no remote Storybooks (`refs: () => ({})`), no static folders or injected head, nothing reported, and a server-channel hook that drops every handler that fetches, writes files or starts programs. The manager's brand title, which Storybook renders as HTML, is the constant "Zurfur Component Gallery". The nodes tool skips hidden folders, so `.storybook/` is described here.
Installs only through the workspace's guarded trio (`just frontend-install`), never a bare `yarn install` here.

`node src/checks/built-output.ts build` runs after every Kit build, and `just gallery-build` runs `build-storybook` then `node src/checks/built-output.ts --storybook storybook-static`, both in `just gate`, `just gate-light` and CI's `ui` job: it refuses remote URLs a page loads by itself in the built CSS and HTML, any `http-equiv` but Kit's `content-security-policy`, and the text `ZURFUR_` or `DATABASE_URL` in any text file; in Storybook mode a remote `<a href>` is allowed under `https://storybook.js.org/docs/` alone (exit 0 clean, 1 findings, 2 unreadable).
The token files are never edited by hand: `yarn tokens:copy <version>` recopies the design system's file, `yarn tokens` regenerates `tokens.css` (see `src/lib/styles`).

The components wrap bits-ui: it and `@internationalized/date` are imported only by `.svelte` files under `src/lib`, never by the gallery host, a route, a check harness or a plain `.ts` file, and no type from either crosses the public entry. A spread attribute is allowed only on an HTML element and only when it spreads the `props` or `wrapperProps` of the nearest `{#snippet child(…)}` that only bits-ui can render (it sits right under a bits-ui component, or is handed to one as `child` and used nowhere else; IconButton alone may also hand it to Tooltip as `trigger`); every other spread is refused, on components too, and `<svelte:element>` is refused except in the files the rule lists. Svelte's context functions are called only in `src/lib/environment`, and the shipped tier may not call `provideEnvironment`. `web` imports only the packages it declares, which does not include bits-ui.

fs.name: .gitignore
fs.role: ignores this package's build output (.svelte-kit/, build/, storybook-static/) and .env*

fs.name: .prettierignore
fs.role: lockfiles, static/, storybook-static/, NODE.inf.json files (the nodes tool formats those), the token files (tokens.json, tokens.css) and src/app.html (pinned by hash) are not formatted

fs.name: .storybook/
fs.role: Storybook's config, exactly main.ts, preview.ts (tokens, the Skin and Motion globals, the frame decorator, the accessibility rules, the sidebar order, the Still check), manager.ts (the brand title) and vitest.setup.ts; a security trigger

fs.name: eslint.config.js
fs.role: type-aware lint with the file-set partition of src/ (storage and environment sets included), the boundary rules and the package rules (ui/import-tiers: no relative import into a looser tier or out of src/, and a relative import of a file that is neither code nor CSS counts as the loosest tier unless it ends in exactly ?raw or ?url; ui/no-remote-string: no http:, https: or protocol-relative string; ui/no-script-url: no javascript: string; ui/spreads: a spread only of bits-ui's snippet props on an HTML element; the ban on context functions and on `provideEnvironment` in the shipped tier); the boundary syntax bans also refuse markup that runs script or loads another document, inline event-handler attributes included; exports boundaryRules, fileSetOf and the bans' messages (rawHtmlMessage, scriptMarkupMessage, inlineHandlerMessage, httpEquivMessage, STORAGE_MESSAGE, HOST_STORAGE_MESSAGE) for the checks

fs.name: gallery-port.ts
fs.role: the gallery's one port rule (ZURFUR_GALLERY_PORT, or 5190), Node built-ins only; run as `node gallery-port.ts` it prints the port for the storybook script

fs.name: package.json
fs.role: @zurfur/ui 0.0.0: the exports map (the library entry, ./styles, ./tokens.json, ./tokens.additions.json), yarn scripts (dev/build/preview/check/lint, test and test:unit, storybook and build-storybook, tokens and tokens:copy; the Storybook and Vitest ones under env -i and the network guard), the dependencies (the two Atkinson Fontsource packages, bits-ui and @internationalized/date) and the dev dependencies (Storybook 10.6.2 and its addons, Playwright among them); svelte is a peer

fs.name: prettier.config.js
fs.role: tabs, single quotes, no trailing comma, width 100

fs.name: src/
fs.role: the library, the Storybook stories and frame, the old gallery frame and routes, and the repo-shape checks

fs.name: tsconfig.json
fs.role: strict + noUncheckedIndexedAccess + exactOptionalPropertyTypes + erasableSyntaxOnly, kept equal to web's by a check

fs.name: vite.config.ts
fs.role: adapter-static (strict), runes forced outside node_modules, the $gallery alias, 127.0.0.1 server and preview on the gallery port with strictPort, bits-ui and the date library pre-bundled so the browser specs load once, and the vitest projects: browser by *.svelte.spec.ts, node for the rest, client-media (the one media spec with the emulateMedia command, run after the others), and the two story projects, stories (Paper dark, the one Storybook's test panel runs) and stories-light-still (Paper light with Still and reduced motion, CLI only)
